sources.title: OsaurusAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-JANGH2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A JANG bundle of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Liquid AI's 24B mixture-of-experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters (40 layers: 30 short-convolution and 10 full-attention, 64 routed experts with 4 active, two dense layers), built for on-device agents.

sources.snippet: A JANG bundle of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Liquid AI's 24B mixture-of-experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters (40 layers: 30 short-convolution and 10 full-attention, 64 routed experts with 4 active, two dense layers), built for on-device agents.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: an open-weight 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agents. Beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw.

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B is an open-weight 24B MoE reasoning model with 2B active parameters for fast on-device agents.

sources.title: Osaurus: Privacy isn't extinct.
sources.snippet: Powerful AI agents that live on your computer, not in someone else's cloud. Whatever you use them for, it stays with you.
